analogy.rationale: Homoquinolinic acid is a glutamate receptor (NMDA) agonist, so a binding inhibitor would block glutamate signaling; however, these cell lines are non-neuronal and express little NMDA receptor, so transcriptional response should be minimal. Other neurotransmitter receptor classes acting on receptors these cells barely express should similarly produce little or no response.
